messages.name: execute

args.sparql:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?film ?filmLabel ?director ?directorBirth ?otherDirector ?otherDirectorBirth WHERE {
  VALUES ?film { dbr:Men_Are_Such_Fools_(1932_film) dbr:Waiter_(film) }
  ?film dbo:director ?director .
  ?director dbo:birthDate ?directorBirth .

  # find the other film and its director birthdate
  VALUES ?otherFilm { dbr:Men_Are_Such_Fools_(1932_film) dbr:Waiter_(film) }
  FILTER(?otherFilm != ?film)
  ?otherFilm dbo:director ?otherDirector .
  ?otherDirector dbo:birthDate ?otherDirectorBirth .

  # choose the film whose director was born later (greater date)
  FILTER(xsd:date(?directorBirth) > xsd:date(?otherDirectorBirth))

  OPTIONAL { ?film rdfs:label ?filmLabel . FILTER(lang(?filmLabel) = 'en') }
}

args.sparql:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?film ?filmLabel ?director ?directorBirth ?otherDirector ?otherDirectorBirth WHERE {
  VALUES ?film { dbr:Men_Are_Such_Fools_(1932_film) dbr:Waiter_(film) }
  ?film dbo:director ?director .
  ?director dbo:birthDate ?directorBirth .

  # find the other film and its director birthdate
  VALUES ?otherFilm { dbr:Men_Are_Such_Fools_(1932_film) dbr:Waiter_(film) }
  FILTER(?otherFilm != ?film)
  ?otherFilm dbo:director ?otherDirector .
  ?otherDirector dbo:birthDate ?otherDirectorBirth .

  # choose the film whose director was born later (greater date)
  FILTER(xsd:date(?directorBirth) > xsd:date(?otherDirectorBirth))

  OPTIONAL { ?film rdfs:label ?filmLabel . FILTER(lang(?filmLabel) = 'en') }
}
